constraints.models: same frozen E/H identities, no new model search
constraints.original_27_contexts: closed; no parameter tuning to manufacture a sharing outcome
constraints.direction_budget_landmarks: must be frozen from CPU evidence before any future GPU outcomes
constraints.new_replica_counts: unmeasured counts remain unknown; additional profiling needs a new explicit active-optimum witness and separate authorization

hypothesis: Uniform Heavy replacement at the original 27 contexts changes only Specialist structure. Concurrent pressure on multiple overlapping tasks may create a distinct, legal G/S substitution window, because affordable Specialist parallel capacity can be jointly exhausted while a Generalist offers shared headroom. This is an untested hypothesis.

proposed_design.CPU_scope: Enumerate frozen task-pool single/pair/triple hotspot directions with corrected memory and measured capacities; exclude VQA as an S-only hotspot because it has no Specialist path.
proposed_design.window_required: C_S^op < fixed workload direction < empirically stable system boundary
proposed_design.certification: Do not treat x3 evidence bound as a physical Specialist terminal. Resolve active missing-count frontiers or prove actual fixed-budget exclusion without invented M(next).
proposed_design.landmarks: Freeze direction, existing budget, H0/H1/H2/H3 from legitimate CPU boundaries before future hotspot GPU measurements.
proposed_design.second_G: Only a separately legal capacity AND latency window can support 1G->2G; no memory-only 2G success.
proposed_design.success: Multiple stable repeated sharing/split events with real task paths and budget-valid residency.
proposed_design.falsification: No legal stable window or systematically invalidated CPU trend; stop without moving hotspot/budget/model/SLO.
